record: *** Transvaal Provincial Gazette no. 4793, 11 December 1991, page 75 ***
what the snippet shows: "...spection during normal office hours at the office John Landman, *** Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena *** ... behalf of Madeleine Ross, Brian John Town Clerk..."
caution: *** GAZETTE OCR INTERLEAVES COLUMNS. *** The words 'John Landman' and 'Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena' sit beside each other in the snippet and *** that is not evidence they sit beside each other on the page *** - a two-column notice reads across the gutter. No relationship between the names is asserted.
status: *** NEW. *** Ricardo Juan Carlos died 21 December 1994, so this falls in his lifetime. A township notice is a *** property fact ***, and this archive holds none for him.
